_fixture: SYNTHETIC. Reproduces the SHAPE of a shipped sauron rescore artifact: the same 18 dimensions as baseline.json, each an object rather than a bare number, in all three structural variants that ship — {before,after,evidence,residual,backlog}, the same without a backlog ref, and the nonActionable form. Scores and prose are invented; this is not a copy of any real evaluations/ artifact.

writeIntegrity.evidence: atomic writes under a single writer lock, with a conservation invariant asserted in tests
writeIntegrity.residual: fsync durability is out of the stated threat model

boundaryConsistency.evidence: every seam returns a pinned {rows, state} contract
boundaryConsistency.residual: three same-named constants documented rather than renamed

statusValidity.evidence: unparseable / unreadable / unverified all landed as distinct states with tests
statusValidity.residual: two coexisting vocabularies for the same absence

pathCompleteness.evidence: every new write has a consuming reader
pathCompleteness.residual: the panel renders none of the new states — the human reader is missing

crossInvocationSafety.evidence: re-runs are idempotent under a pinned clock override
crossInvocationSafety.residual: concurrent invocation is serialised by lock, not proven safe

errorResilience.evidence: only ENOENT is treated as legitimate absence; every other errno refuses
errorResilience.residual: partial-read recovery is untested on a torn final line

fractalConsistency.evidence: the same refuse-don't-coerce rule holds at each nesting level

clusterTopology.evidence: related checks were grouped behind one registry
clusterTopology.residual: cluster boundaries follow the file layout rather than the data

voidCoverage.evidence: the absent-input case is now a named state in each lane
voidCoverage.residual: no coverage of an input present but zero-length

spectralCoherence.evidence: one vocabulary for verdicts across all emitters
spectralCoherence.residual: report headings still carry the pre-unification wording

branchCoverage.evidence: each verdict arm is exercised by at least one assertion
branchCoverage.residual: the unreachable defensive arms stay uncovered by design

adversarialResistance.evidence: hostile inputs are rejected before any path is joined
adversarialResistance.residual: signing of stored records is out of the threat model

reversionSafety.evidence: every write is tmp+rename, so a crash leaves the prior file intact

seamIntegrity.evidence: the module boundary is asserted by a contract test, not by convention

idempotency.evidence: byte-identical output for identical input under a pinned clock

temporalSafety.evidence: the clock is read at call time and overridable
temporalSafety.residual: timezone handling is unspecified for the render layer

authPiiBoundary.evidence: no credential or personal field crosses into a generated artifact
authPiiBoundary.residual: redaction is allowlist-based, so a new field defaults to visible

evidenceQuality.evidence: citations carry file and rule, deliberately never a line number
evidenceQuality.residual: evidence is not itself re-verified at render time

followOnBridge.item: render the new states in the panel
followOnBridge.note: the human reader is the missing consumer

asymptote: further gains need a second independent rater, not more assertions
